description: This Java class 'MidiPrinter' provides utility methods for formatting MIDI messages, device information, and related data for printing or logging purposes within an Android application dealing with MIDI devices.

classes.name: MidiPrinter
classes.description: Utility class for formatting MIDI messages, device info, and related data for display or logging.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of a MIDI status byte, identifying the MIDI message type or system command.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a segment of a byte array as a string of hexadecimal values.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Converts a MIDI message byte array into a human-readable string, including message type, channel, and data bytes.

methods.name: formatDeviceInfo
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a MidiDeviceInfo object, including its properties and ports.
